name: Santa in the Cabin at the Scout Cabin
host: City of Hudson and the Rotary Club of Hudson
when_note: Saturday, December 5, 9 AM to 3 PM, free timed tickets handed out from 8 AM
paras: The Rotary Club of Hudson brings Santa and Mrs. Claus back to downtown Hudson on Saturday, December 5, with visits inside the restored Scout Cabin at 2 W Streetsboro St. The day runs from 9 AM to 3 PM and is listed on the City of Hudson calendar as a free event.
Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive by fire truck at 9 AM. Families then have a cozy visit by the glowing fireplace in the decorated cabin, and friendly elves help with photos, so bring a camera.

Visits are scheduled in hourly slots with 20 families each hour. A total of 120 free tickets, each with an assigned visit time, are handed out from 8 AM at the Gazebo on a first come, first served basis. Families enter the cabin from the rear, where parking is available, and hot chocolate and candy canes are served outside.
tip: Pick up free tickets at the Gazebo starting at 8 AM, since only 120 are handed out.
